method: Pixel rows/columns read from a colour segmentation (hood blue, skin, hair) plus a 50 px gridded overlay; values in px of the source image.
assumptions: Bare head = hood minus a thin shell of ~5% of hood size on each side (top 58 instead of 40; width 353*0.9).
Body shoulder width = cape width at the shoulder line minus ~15% cape bulk.
Crotch hidden by the dress; estimated at y 570 from the leg angle and hem.
Eye spacing is foreshortened by the 3/4 view; frontal spacing estimated as measured / cos(~25 deg).
Base-body 'hem' guide = bottom of the undergarment zone, placed at the reference dress hem height.

Eye rows (2026-09-28, avatar-fit): per-row extents of the dark eye pixels; iris = rows below the lid line (258-262 are clean), lid = the widest dark run near the top. The eye_spacing_centres_frontal_est '/cos 25' guess is superseded by face_on_head, fitted by measure_face_ref18.py.

ratios_of_body_height.note: body height = bare head top (58) to sole (758) = 700 px

face_on_head.method: measure_face_ref18.py: yaw, eye longitude and iris half-width fitted to both iris centres and widths through the v6 head (orthographic 3/4 model, mouth on the centre line); heights read directly.
